reason: Pages 5-7 of this MS have a garbled text layer (every glyph doubled: '(ii ii)', '(c c)', '4 (a a) ( (i)'), so the splitter read only the bare '4' and lost the keys of 3(b)(iii), 3(c) and every part of question 4 (Q4 was being shown whole to each part). The printed keys are placed by hand from the page images: p5 (iii) y106, (c) y240, 4(a)(i) y352.5, (ii) y377, (iii) y426.7, (iv) y505; p6 (v) y106, (vi) y196, (b)(i) y271, (ii) y295.5, (iii) y320.7, (iv) y345, (v) y383; p7 (vi) y106, (vii) y282.4, (viii) y306.9 - matching the QP parts 4(a)(i)-(vi) and 4(b)(i)-(viii). The garbled pages' running header, column-heading row and footer are not recognised as furniture (doubled glyphs), so the parts running to a page end are cut by hand to stop at the table's bottom rule (3(b)(ii) p4 only; 4(a)(iv) p5 to y522.5; 4(b)(v) p6 to y400.5; 4(b)(viii) p7 to y361.5, keeping the [22] total row as on the other pages), and the header block (y33-95) and footer line (y548-562) of pages 5-7 are whited out by hand.
